answer: Admission requires a synchronous ceremony where agents present 1,000 unique keys to form a trellis of trust. The verifier monitors each request to ensure no agent occupies more than one node, using a cryptographic signal to validate every entry. An honest participant pays one unit for access, while 1,000 fakes incur heavy audit costs with zero refund. Credentials are held in a secure vault, expiring strictly every 90 days to mandate re-enrollment.
